map.估计在给定误差、置信水平和总体标准差下所需的最小样本量。: Estimates the minimum sample size required for a given error, confidence level and population standard deviation.
map.📖 查看「样本量估算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Sample Size Estimation User Guide"
map.均值估计 n = ⌈(z·σ / e)²⌉；比例估计 n = ⌈z²·p(1−p: Mean estimation n = ⌈(z·σ / e)²⌉; proportion estimation n = ⌈z²·p(1−p) / e²⌉
map.按给定置信水平反解 z 后估计最小样本量：均值估计用 n = (z·σ/e)²，: After inverting z from the confidence level, the minimum sample size is estimated as n = (z·σ/e)² for a mean, where σ is the estimated population standard deviation and e the tolerated error, and as n = z²·p(1−p)/e² for a proportion, where p is the expected proportion. Results are rounded up to whole observations for planning samples in surveys and experiments.
map.📚 深度解析：置信水平与临界值: 📚 In-depth: Confidence Level and Critical Values
map.由置信水平查临界 z/t 值。: Looks up the critical z or t value from the confidence level.
map.区间宽度随置信水平增大。: The interval widens as the confidence level rises.
map.双尾 95% 对应 z=1.96（每尾 2.5%）；99% 对应 z=2.576: Two-tailed 95% corresponds to z=1.96 (2.5% in each tail); 99% corresponds to z=2.576 (0.5% per tail).
map.提置信到 99% 区间更宽（更保守但更含糊），是精度与把握的权衡。: Raising confidence to 99% widens the interval (more conservative but vaguer), a trade-off between precision and assurance.
map.置信水平越高越好？: Is a higher confidence level always better?
map.越高区间越宽、越不精确；选 95% 是惯例平衡，特殊领域用 99% 或 90%。: A higher level means a wider and less precise interval; 95% is the conventional balance, with 99% or 90% used in specific fields.
map.z 和 t 临界区别？: How do z and t critical values differ?
map.小样本/σ 未知用 t 临界（随 df 变、略大于 z）；大样本 t≈z。: Small samples or unknown σ call for t critical values (which vary with df and run slightly above z); with large samples t≈z.
